prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Lu Zhi of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the scholar-general who taught Liu Bei and Gongsun Zan.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours.
Face — a poised adult woman, no beard or facial hair; porcelain-pale skin; a rounded compact heart face, short midface and a small soft chin, naturally open teal-green eyes, straight brows, softly broad nose and pale rose lips.
Body and hair: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; a short layered pixie cut with a long swept forelock; pale sky-blue hair.
Expression: a quiet, confident near-smile.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: Confucian dignity and military skill, scholar's robe over armor.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as an assault-type mecha frame — heavy armor plates, thruster packs, reinforced limbs, her weapon rebuilt as a large mecha armament. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight’s plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows. All surfaces are thick hard alloy, black and vermilion with gold and jade trim and vermilion glow lines; no cloth. The layered waist plates are shaped as short hinged book covers with embossed spine ribs and interlocking clasps, while the rounded shoulder guards open in paired rigid leaves like a scholar’s folio. A deep chest window and bare upper arms contrast with fully plated limbs, symmetrical armor.
Colours: Han black and vermilion, gold and jade. Faction frame: black and vermilion lacquer plating with gold and jade trim, dignified Han court silhouette, ceremonial crest shapes, vermilion glow lines.
Signature item: a classic text and sword, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking.
Pose and setting: standing on an empty spacecraft maintenance dais inside a Free Zones orbital academy, body angled slightly left and head facing the viewer; left hand supports a closed armored data-book at her waist, right hand holds one long complete high-tech sword upright beside her right shoulder with a narrow vermilion energy edge; both feet planted; docking lights and the asteroid field visible through a broad station window.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
